$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFKC (AIP France, chart dated 2026-03-19): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
RWY 18/36 isn't operated with crosswinds greater than or equal to 20 kt if the RWY is wet.
ULM activity: AD authorized for class 2, 3, 4 et 6 ULMs equipped with radio and mode C transponder:; use of AD may be subject to pilot's ability to integrate into aerodrome traffic.
Use of helistop within a 8 km radius from ARP: PPR from ATS for agreement request form (see ATS).
Caution to pilots: on approach RWY 36, roadway nearby.
AD likely to be covered by sea haze in a few minutes.

With severe winds: Arrivals and departures via pass of MARSOLINU are not advised (possible presence of severe down draughts).; Risk of turbulences in the vicinity of aerodrome when proceeding the approach.; Rocky obstacle located West of threshold 18 lighted along 380 meters.
Possibility of turbulence due to this obstacle.
Low height circuits: reserved for instruction needs. l'instruction.
Circuits à l'Est de la RWY 500ft (300 ft).
Circuits on the East of the RWY 500 ft (300 ft).
Avoid overflight of the industrial area.
Preferred QFU 177° due to IFR procedure.
RWY with descending slope 2 % after THR 36.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
TWY A (width 13.5 m) limited to code B ACFT whose tail fin height < 11 m.
TWY B (width 23 m) limited to code D ACFT whose main gear overall width < 9 m.
TWY C (width 11 m) limited to code A ACFT (wing-span < 12 m).
D APRON: ACFT operating on D apron are under the responsibility of the Coordinating Ground Handling Agent.
ACFT movements on D apron are done clockwise.
Access to pedestrian paths are prohibited, ground mouvements provided by the Ground Handling Agents vehicle only.
S arrival: Preferential altitude before radio contact 1500 ft AMSL minimum.
Unpredictable radio contact below 1500 ft AMSL.
Report on E, W at 1200 ft AMSL (1000 ft ASFC).
OVERSEAS FLIGHTS: CALVI / CONTINENT / CALVI: see AIP FRANCE and additional book to aeronautical charts.
Traffic surveillance equipment: AD equipped with a radar display (see AD 1.0).
